config.customersNote: 80–100 attendees × 60–75% = 48–75 lunch customers. Days 1–3 sized for the top of the range (75). Day 4 sized for the middle (62) to minimise leftovers.
config.portionsNote: Sauce, mustard, sugar and milk are averages across all customers (not everyone takes them): e.g. sugar 4 g = about half of customers taking one 8 g teaspoon; milk 25 ml ≈ 80% taking 30 ml.

card.checkedNote: Stripe AU: in-person Terminal domestic cards 1.65% + A$0.10; Tap to Pay adds A$0.15 per authorisation. Fees include GST.

float.note: Notes: expected change paid out to the first half of the day's cash customers (the lunch rush, before notes come back in) × 1.5. Coins: expected change for ALL cash customers × 2, because coins rarely come back. Every likely basket and tender is considered. Tender mix is an editable guess; note 0 = exact money.

compliance.title: FIRST: phone the Alpine Shire environmental health officer — 4 consecutive days
compliance.detail: Safe Food Victoria's community-fundraiser guidance applies to food handling at a premises 'for no more than two consecutive days at any one time'. This event trades 4 days in a row (possibly at the same site). Ask the EHO to confirm the class and what to lodge, and note their name and date here. Also ask whether tea/coffee made with hot water stays within Class 4.

compliance.title: Class 4 notification via FoodTrader to the club's principal council
compliance.detail: The principal council is the council where the club is based (its registered address). Notify once for the club; it covers Class 4 events across Victoria.
compliance.due: Before lodging the Statements of Trade

compliance.title: Statement of Trade — Alpine Shire (Mystic Park, Tawonga Gap)
compliance.detail: Lodge in FoodTrader at least 5 days before trading: by Mon 26 Oct 2026. Covers Sat 31 Oct – Tue 3 Nov.

compliance.title: Statement of Trade — Indigo Shire (Gundowring)
compliance.detail: Lodge by Mon 26 Oct 2026 in case we fly at Gundowring. WITHDRAW whichever Statement of Trade is not used.

compliance.title: Read the Class 4 sausage sizzle rules
compliance.detail: Class 4 = sausages, onion, sauce, bread + tea, coffee, bottled water, soft drinks only. Nothing else on the stall. (The old health.vic.gov.au Class 4 page now returns 'not found' — Victorian food-safety guidance has moved to Safe Food Victoria.)

compliance.title: Volunteers: free DoFoodSafely course (recommended)
compliance.detail: Not mandatory for Class 4, but recommended for anyone cooking or serving.

compliance.title: FoodTrader user guide
compliance.detail: How to register the club and lodge/withdraw a Statement of Trade.

compliance.title: Fire Danger Period / Total Fire Ban — check every morning
compliance.detail: Check whether Alpine / Indigo is in the Fire Danger Period and whether a Total Fire Ban is declared for the North East district. On a TFB day a gas BBQ may only be used under the CFA's conditions (e.g. clear 3 m around, water/extinguisher at hand, attended at all times) — check the CFA 'Can I or can't I' rules.

compliance.title: Food safety on the day
compliance.detail: Raw sausages, onions and opened milk at ≤5 °C in the Dometic. Gloves for handling bread and cooked food. Separate VEG zone on the hotplate and separate VEG tongs. Cook sausages through — probe the thickest sausage (≥75 °C, no pink). Handwash station set up before cooking starts. Throw out cooked leftovers at the end of each day.
